automatic_scope: policy alias and baseline call accounting
candidate-present, structurally-executable, in-support and abstention counts inherited from E1/E3
response.note: Response quality and grounding risk remain separate E6/E7 constructs; E5 must not infer them from resource use or lexical guards.

qa.prediction_surface_normalization: Reproduce official qa_experiment.py: prediction.replace('*','').replace('#','').strip('Answer:').strip(). Raw E4 output remains immutable and is also retained.
qa.token_f1: Reproduce official set-overlap F1: lowercase; regex \W+ to one space; whitespace split; unique-token set intersection; precision=|common|/|prediction tokens|; recall=|common|/|gold tokens|; zero when common is empty.

bertscore.idf: all ordinary tokens 1.0; CLS and SEP 0.0

aggregation: macro mean over all 418 questions for each condition
macro mean by released capability for each condition
no filtering by observed answer quality
retrieval Recall@4 and nDCG@4 remain the E3 evaluator-only metrics on exactly 341 mappable questions
qa.llm_as_judge: not E5; separate E6 robustness metric and never training gold
